# Brackenmouth

A warren dug into the clay of the Sallowrun's bank by tooth and tool, on [[The FellGuide/The FellGuide/The Lore (Contains Spoilers)/The Sphere/Stratums/Shervinaw|Shervinaw]]. It is the only settlement on the world with stone in its walls, the home of the diggers who built it, and tonight the refuge of two hundred Shrewish from the Slumpwood.

A stair runs up from the barley cellar to a long great hall on stone pillars. From the hall, another stair goes down to the lower tunnels, where Nib's shaft is, and a ramp goes down to the bottom end, where the larders are cut into the clay. At the far end of the hall, the river arch opens onto a stone quay inside the bank, with ten rafts tied along it and the river sliding past.
